# Dan's Hairstyling

> Old-school barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Regulars say Dan's been cutting hair in East Austin for more than 50 years. Razor fades, a straight-razor finish on the neck and good conversation in the yellow house on Diaz St.

- Phone: (512) 517-2172
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, East Cesar Chavez, Holly, Govalle, Rosewood, Montopolis
- Google rating: 4.8 from 66 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/dans-hairstyling/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/dans-hairstyling/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts: The classic cut, done the way you ask for it, with conversation included.
- Razor fades: Bald fades and razor fades with the precision regulars keep coming back for.
- Straight razor neck trim: A straight-edge razor along the neck and sideburns so the cut stays clean longer.
- Hi-lites & color: Hi-lites, all-over color and ombre, done right in the shop.
- Up-do's & perms: Up-do's for the big day and perms, the old-school way.
- Wax: Eyebrow waxing and more, listed on the window with the rest.

## About
Dan's Hairstyling is a family barbershop run by Dan and Margaret Ojeda. For years it was on E 6th St, where a regular who started coming in first grade called it an original landmark for at least 30 years: straight-edge razors, a checkerboard floor and a family behind the chairs. Today the shop is in the small yellow house with navy trim at 2513 Diaz St, with the services hand-lettered on the front window. Regulars say Dan has been cutting hair for more than 50 years. Some have sat in his chair for decades: one customer's dad has been coming for 38 years, and he and his brother got cuts at 6 AM before school. Dan's daughter cuts here too, and the doors still open early.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What time do you open?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 6:30 AM to 5:45 PM, and Saturday 5:30 AM to 4 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 2513 Diaz St, Austin, TX 78702. It's the yellow house with navy trim; look for the red DAN'S BARBER SHOP sign on the sidewalk.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Call (512) 517-2172 to check on a chair before you come in. Regulars often wait for their own barber, so a quick call saves you time.
- Q: Do you cut kids' and women's hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts and fades, women's cuts, plus hi-lites, color, up-do's, perms and wax.
- Q: Didn't Dan's used to be on E 6th St?
  A: Yes. The shop was on E 6th St for many years and now it's at 2513 Diaz St, a few minutes away. Same family, same razor fades.
- Q: Do you rent chairs to other barbers?
  A: Yes, there are guest spots for barbers. Call Dan at (512) 517-2172 or Margaret at (512) 433-9956.
